name: Bahamas Business Solutions Limited
brand_truth: The Bahamas' Xerox company since 1966: sixty years in the document business, with its own engineers on two islands.
buyer: Office managers, procurement and IT leads at government, banks, utilities, healthcare and hotels in Grand Bahama and New Providence; plus walk-in print customers.

design.signature: R3F fanned stack of six documents BBSL produces (proof, plan, NCR receipt, Neopost letter, wide-format poster, OnBase record) with hover/tap hotspots; product-line index; service-plan coverage chooser; tabbed quote router to sales/service/copy inboxes; office switcher; Document Centre job-ticket builder

current_site_findings: Every page of bbsl.com carries a noindex, nofollow tag, so Google is told not to list the site.
The homepage is a slogan and five vendor logos: no explanation of what you sell or service, or where.
No street address for the Freeport or Nassau office on the pages reviewed.
Service plans are buried in one paragraph and cannot be compared.
A leftover shop message, 'has been added to the cart', shows on every page.
pitch_line: Your website has been telling Google not to list you, so when a Freeport office searches for a Xerox dealer they never find the company that has been the Xerox dealer since 1966; this version fixes that and puts your two office numbers, service plans and quote form on the first screens.
assumptions: Freeport address shown as Queens Highway, Freeport (from LinkedIn snippet only)
Time & materials shown as 'billed per visit' (paraphrase)
Full-service plan consumables shown as 'Ask us'
One-line descriptions under Document Centre services are category descriptions
Riso shown only as 'also on our vendor list'
notes: Record said no own site, but bbsl.com is live (WordPress/WooCommerce) and carries noindex,nofollow: treated as Track A, the noindex is the lead pitch. No usable photos (vendor logos only); visuals are procedural 3D paper and print-production typography. Ask owner for showroom, Document Centre and engineer photos, Freeport hours, TCI address. Interact: index 0 errors/0 dead, document-centre 0 errors/0 dead. Rebuilt on the React stack, replacing an earlier static build of this slug.
